caption: The drawing depicts a single object, which is a carved and painted wooden duck decoy positioned in profile facing to the right. The duck's body is predominantly dark brown to black with lighter brown highlights, and there is a visible patch of green on the wing. The head is a lighter, mottled brown shade with a gradient that transitions into a darker area near the base of the beak. The beak itself is a muted brown color. The surface of the duck is smooth with some carved feather details marked by lighter, curved lines along the back and wing area. The background is a plain, off-white color with no other objects or details present. The duck decoy is centered horizontally on the canvas and occupies most of the visual space.
title: Decoy
